name: Karnal Agricultural Belt
summary: India's breadbasket facing dual perils of extreme March terminal heat stress and acute groundwater aquifer depletion.

hotspots.title: Overexploited Central Alluvial Aquifer
hotspots.description: Deep alluvial aquifer strata supplying 92% of local irrigation for intensive paddy.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Aquifer depth plunges beyond 95m, causing widespread saline ingress and dry borewells.
hotspots.impactProtect: Direct seeded rice (DSR) and aquifer recharge shafts restore water table equilibrium to <40m.

hotspots.title: Wheat Experimental Canopy & Salt Research Fields
hotspots.description: Prime agricultural research corridor developing climate-hardy cereal varieties.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Terminal heat stress >38°C shrivels grains, slashing farm profitability by over 55%.
hotspots.impactProtect: Adoption of heat-tolerant wheat strains (PBW-1Zn/DBW-303) and drip fertigation stabilizes yields.

hotspots.title: Grain Mandi & Rural Cold Storage Hub
hotspots.description: Critical regional food logistics terminal handling multi-state wheat and basmati commerce.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Chronic summer power grid trippings and heat stress cause substantial grain post-harvest spoilage.
hotspots.impactProtect: Solarized micro-grids and decentralized insulated grain silos safeguard regional food reserves.

stats.label: Wheat Harvest Yield
stats.context: Average Rabi season wheat productivity vulnerable to terminal heat shock during March grain-fill.

stats.label: Tube-Well Drilling Cost
stats.context: Capital cost required by smallholder farmers to drill deeper submersible boreholes as shallow aquifers fail.

stats.label: Groundwater Depth
stats.context: Depth to water table below surface in the intensive rice-wheat alluvial plain.

stats.label: Extreme Heatwave Days
stats.context: Annual days exceeding 42°C, severely curtailing agricultural daytime labor capacity.

carryOn.description: Terminal heat waves collapse cereal grain weights while plunging groundwater forces capital-intensive deep tube-wells, precipitating rural agrarian debt.
keyPoints: Wheat yields contract by over 38% due to March heat spikes
Tube-well re-drilling costs exceed ₹180k per bore as water table falls below 90m
Over 45 days per year exceed dangerous 42°C threshold for agricultural laborers

protect.description: Widespread adoption of direct-seeded rice, laser land leveling, and heat-resilient cultivars stabilizes the aquifer and secures national food supply.
keyPoints: Wheat productivity preserved at >4.6 tonnes/ha with heat-tolerant cultivars
Groundwater table stabilized at sustainable 36m with artificial recharge
Solar irrigation pumps and farm solarization slash agricultural operating costs
